trends.name: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol expand tool execution at lower cost
trends.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, citing improved efficiency in professional output, coding and computer operation, along with lower API costs.
trends.attention_driver: Model capabilities, pricing and third-party access points were updated on the same day.

evidence.quote: Introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol, with better professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost
evidence.claim: Supports OpenAI's release of two models and its claims of coverage for coding, computer operation and lower costs.

evidence.quote: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
evidence.claim: Supports external reports confirming its price cuts and improvements on some benchmarks.
Supports follow-up from the independent developer community on the release.

evidence.quote: Perplexity 上线 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol，并公布 WANDR 基准成绩
evidence.claim: Supports the rapid entry of the new models into third-party search and computing products.

trends.so_what: Design model routing to switch based on task risk, latency and cost per unit of output, rather than hard-coding a single flagship model into product workflows. Add end-to-end success rate evaluations for high-value execution tasks instead of relying only on vendor benchmarks.

trends.name: Agent execution isolation and tool identity verification gain attention
trends.summary: Sandboxing, MCP tool binding risks and agent framework supply chain incidents emerged at the same time, making execution-layer controls a deployment focus.
trends.attention_driver: Agents that can autonomously call tools expand the exposure surface for code execution and credential leaks.

evidence.claim: Supports developer community interest in sandbox solutions that move agent execution out of local environments.

evidence.quote: When Tool Names Are Not Identities: Measuring Provider Misbinding in MCP-Based AI Agents
evidence.claim: Supports research that has explicitly measured the risk of binding MCP agents to the wrong tool provider.

evidence.quote: Microsoft agent-framework 1.26.1/1.26.2 恶意版本被发布至 PyPI，窃取 Azure 与 CI 凭据
evidence.claim: Supports growing concern that agent framework dependency chains may become an entry point for credential theft.

trends.so_what: Put isolated environments, least privilege and tool provider identity verification into the default product path, and retain auditable evidence for every execution. Where keys or external write operations are involved, make approval and rollback core interactions.

trends.name: Open-weight models and composable agent components spread
trends.summary: Hugging Face and OpenRouter lower the barrier to running open-weight models, while the community releases models, agents and user interface components.
trends.attention_driver: Development teams seek model choices with lower migration costs and controllable deployment.

evidence.quote: Hugging Face and OpenRouter join forces to make open-weight models easy to run
evidence.claim: Supports a further reduction in the barriers to running and accessing open-weight models.

evidence.quote: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
evidence.claim: Supports the continued expansion of open model supply into multi-size model combinations.

evidence.quote: An open-source take on ChatGPT's Intelligent UI
evidence.claim: Supports the community's release of open agent user interface components.

evidence.quote: 材料科学智能体MatOS正式开源！大幅提高材料研发任务成功率
evidence.claim: Supports the continued emergence of open-source agent projects for specific tasks.

trends.so_what: Keep replaceable boundaries for the model, tool and interface layers to avoid locking product capabilities into a single hosted provider. The value of self-hosting depends on whether operations, latency and data control outweigh the added complexity.

insights.text: Routing design replaces single-model lock-in: price cuts and access to open models are appearing together, so products need to select models by task cost and success rate
Tool identity becomes a release requirement: MCP misbinding and dependency poisoning both point to gaps in default protections for execution paths
Cost signals are appearing in concentration: this issue has 5 pricing and cost change signals, so monetization design needs room for price adjustments

since_last: The 5 trends from the previous issue did not reappear in this issue.
2 days remain until the OpenAI access policy update.
